Google Inactive Account Manager review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026

Verdict: Free and essential if you use Google. Set it up today: after a period of inactivity you choose, Google notifies up to 10 people and can share selected data with them. Best for: Anyone with Gmail, Google Photos or Google Drive.

Key facts

  • Category: Platform legacy settings
  • Pricing: Free.
  • Best for: Anyone with Gmail, Google Photos or Google Drive.
  • Free and takes about 5 minutes
  • Choose which data (Photos, Drive, Gmail and more) each contact can download

Official site / docs ↗

What are the pros and cons of Google Inactive Account Manager?

Pros

  • Free and takes about 5 minutes
  • Choose which data (Photos, Drive, Gmail and more) each contact can download
  • Can delete the account after notifying contacts

Cons

  • Only triggers on inactivity, not on proof of death
  • Contacts download data; they don't take over the account
